summary: Merrivoss quote MV-2006-090 (May 22, 2006) to Nimbravelle Medicines Inc: paired Microsomal CLint and Hepatocyte depletion CLint on 24 compounds from the NM08 aminotriazine series, with matrix assumptions, analytical limits, a five-to-six-week delivery window and a fixed price of $19,200.

title_block.title: Quotation: Paired Liver Systems Clearance
title_block.subtitle: NM08 test article set
lines: Prepared by: Dr M. Larkin, DMPK Study Director

blocks.p: Nimbravelle Medicines Inc has asked Merrivoss Bioanalysis to compare microsomal and hepatocyte clearance for 24 compounds from the NM08 aminotriazine test article set, to check whether microsomal ranking holds in a whole-cell system before compounds are chosen for in vivo work.

list: Human and rat liver microsomes, pooled, 0.5 mg/mL protein
Cryopreserved human and rat hepatocytes, 0.5 x 10^6 viable cells/mL; lots with viability below 75% at thaw are rejected
Test articles at 1 µM; final organic solvent below 0.5%
Compounds supplied by the client as 10 mM DMSO solutions, 50 µL minimum

blocks.p: Analytical limits: LC-MS/MS, lower limit of quantitation 1 nM in incubation matrix (1). Depletion below 20% over the incubation is reported as a lower bound on half-life (2).
(1) Compound-specific tuning included. (2) Typically >60 min in microsomes and >120 min in hepatocytes.

list: Assay worksheet (Excel) with depletion curves and CLint per compound
Final report with matrix acceptance and analytical limits stated before conclusions

blocks.p: Microsomal data within 3 weeks of compound receipt; hepatocyte data and final report 5 to 6 weeks from receipt. Target start: week of 06/05/2006, subject to compound arrival.
Fixed price. Invoiced on issue of the final report, net 30 days. Quote valid 60 days.
